card.name: The digit 2 in exponents and fractions
card.fires_on: The digit 2 (or the ½ sign) inside a formula, fraction, dose ratio or code, such as a squared exponent, the 2 in 1/2 or 50/25, or in aircraft names.

modes.label: Squared exponent
modes.description: The 2 after a caret in a unit or formula, meaning squared.

modes.label: Fractions and ratios
modes.description: The 2 or ½ in a fraction, dose ratio or date after a slash or number.
modes.example: 50/<<2>>5 mcg once daily administered by oral

modes.label: Other numeric codes
modes.description: A 2 inside a model or date code.
modes.example: Army Air Force built DDT "bombs," attaching six-hundred-and-twenty-five-gallon tanks to the underside of the wings of B-<<2>>5s and C-47s

card.plain: It fires on the number 2 when it sits inside a fraction, ratio or squared unit.
